images.caption: Pyramids of south Saqqara, Egypt from the Pyramid of Djoser in Saqqara.  The Red Pyramid is the large pyramid to the right, the Bent Pyramid is in the middle background with the Pyramid of Pepi II in front of that.  The Mastabat al-Fir'aun is the rectangular mound to the left and the Black Pyramid of Amenemhat III is to the far left.
images.alt: Pyramids of south Saqqara, Egypt from the Pyramid of Djoser in Saqqara.  The Red Pyramid is the large pyramid to the right, the Bent Pyramid is in the middle background with the Pyramid of Pepi II in front of that.  The Mastabat al-Fir'aun is the rectangular mound to the left and the Black Pyramid of Amenemhat III is to the far left.

images.caption: Pyramids of south Saqqara, Egypt from the Pyramid of Djoser in Saqqara.  The Red Pyramid is the large pyramid in the center, the Bent Pyramid is in the middle background with the Pyramid of Pepi II in front of that.  The Mastabat al-Fir'aun is the rectangular mound to the left and the Black Pyramid of Amenemhat III is to the left of that (behind the small building).  The Pyramid of Senusret III is second from the left and the Pyramid of Djedkare Isesi is in the far left (in front of the guy's hat).
images.alt: Pyramids of south Saqqara, Egypt from the Pyramid of Djoser in Saqqara.  The Red Pyramid is the large pyramid in the center, the Bent Pyramid is in the middle background with the Pyramid of Pepi II in front of that.  The Mastabat al-Fir'aun is the rectangular mound to the left and the Black Pyramid of Amenemhat III is to the left of that (behind the small building).  The Pyramid of Senusret III is second from the left and the Pyramid of Djedkare Isesi is in the far left (in front of the guy's hat).
